conceptual_change: Transitioning from simple mean-distance thresholds to a normalized relative-volume ratio interaction. Instead of checking raw distance, this evaluates the intensity of vwap-deviation scaled against current volume surges, identifying mean-reversion triggers when relative price distance is compressed during low-volume accumulation.
rationale: This candidate is a proposed executable test derived from the selected screen survivor. It does not assert efficacy, causality, market behavior, or any performance result.
